record.bible_text: O Israel<WH03478>, return<WH07725><WTH8798> unto the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>; for thou hast fallen<WH03782><WTH8804> by thine iniquity<WH05771>.

Asshur<WH0804> shall not save<WH03467><WTH8686> us; we will not ride<WH07392><WTH8799> upon horses<WH05483>: neither will we say<WH0559><WTH8799> any more to the work<WH04639> of our hands<WH03027>, <FI>Ye are<Fi> our gods<WH0430>: for in thee the fatherless<WH03490> findeth mercy<WH07355><WTH8792>.<CM>
I will heal<WH07495><WTH8799> their backsliding<WH04878>, I will love<WH0157><WTH8799> them freely<WH05071>: for mine anger<WH0639> is turned away<WH07725><WTH8804> from him.

I will be as the dew<WH02919> unto Israel<WH03478>: he shall grow<WH06524><WTH8799> as the lily<WH07799>, and cast forth<WH05221><WTH8686> his roots<WH08328> as Lebanon<WH03844>. <RF>grow: or, blossom<Rf> <RF>cast...: Heb. strike<Rf>

They that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> under his shadow<WH06738> shall return<WH07725><WTH8799>; they shall revive<WH02421><WTH8762> <FI>as<Fi> the corn<WH01715>, and grow<WH06524><WTH8799> as the vine<WH01612>: the scent<WH02143> thereof <FI>shall be<Fi>  as the wine<WH03196> of Lebanon<WH03844>. <RF>grow: or, blossom<Rf> <RF>scent: or, memorial<Rf><CM>

Ephraim<WH0669> <FI>shall say<Fi> , What have I to do any more with idols<WH06091>? I have heard<WH06030><WTH8804> <FI>him<Fi> , and observed<WH07789><WTH8799> him: I <FI>am<Fi> like a green<WH07488> fir tree<WH01265>. From me is thy fruit<WH06529> found<WH04672><WTH8738>.

Who <FI>is<Fi> wise<WH02450>, and he shall understand<WH0995><WTH8799> these <FI>things<Fi> ? prudent<WH0995><WTH8737>, and he shall know<WH03045><WTH8799> them? for the ways<WH01870> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>are<Fi> right<WH03477>, and the just<WH06662> shall walk<WH03212><WTH8799> in them: but the transgressors<WH06586><WTH8802> shall fall<WH03782><WTH8735> therein.<CM>
